inputs.original_text: TAOISEACH Micheál Martin, speaking in Limerick this past week, said that housing tenancies have increased despite concern at a rise in eviction notices and homelessness in the wake of new rules, introduced by Government on March 1, forcing landlords to provide six-year leases for tenants. The numbers of people in emergency accommodation nationally increased again [...] The post Taoiseach says housing tenancies have increased despite rise in eviction notices and homelessness appeared first on Limerick Post .
inputs.modified_text: The housing debate keeps getting turned into a question of whether landlords might be inconvenienced, while families face eviction and emergency accommodation. Six-year leases from March 1 should be judged by whether they give renters real security—not by whether they preserve the market’s comfort. Tenancy figures mean little when people still can’t rely on keeping a home. Government should prioritize secure, affordable housing and stop making renters bear the consequences of a system that leaves housing out of reach.
